blocks.prompt: 17 (a) An urn contains the first 15 English letters (A-O). Sania is to randomly select 3 letters from the urn. She will win the game if the selected letters are the first three vowel letters. Find the probability of Sania winning the game if: (a) The order of the vowel letters matters
blocks.explanation:
Probability (imkaan) = jeetne wale outcomes \(\div\) kul outcomes. Pehle teen vowels A, E, I hain, aur teeno A se O ke beech hain.
Jab order ahem ho to outcomes tarteeb wale draws hain: \({}^{15}P_{3}\).
Plan: kul tarteeb wale draws ginein, jeetne wala draw ginein, divide karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 15 letters A se O; 3 letters nikalne hain; jeet tab jab A, E, I niklein.
Humein find karna hai: jeetne ki probability jab order ahem ho.
Tareeqa: \(P = \frac{\text{winning outcomes}}{\text{all outcomes}}\), aur har draw ka imkaan barabar hai. Urn sirf ek martaban (jar) hai jis mein letters ke parchiyan hain.

Kul tarteeb wale draws
\[{}^{15}P_{3} = 15 \times 14 \times 13\]
\[= 2730\]
Kyun: Pehli parchi 15 mein se koi bhi, doosri baqi 14 mein se, teesri baqi 13 mein se. Order ahem hai, is liye permutation.

Jeetne wale draws
\[\text{A, then E, then I: } 1\]
Kyun: Order ahem hai, is liye sirf woh draw jeetega jis mein pehle A, phir E, phir I nikle. E, A, I jaisa draw alag outcome hai aur jeet nahi.

Divide karein
\[P = \dfrac{1}{2730}\]
Kyun: 2730 barabar imkaan wale outcomes mein se sirf ek jeetne wala hai.
Dhyan dein: Numerator mein \(3! = 6\) likhna ghalat hai; woh tab hota jab order ahem na hota lekin hum tarteeb wale outcomes gin rahe hote.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{1}{15} \times \dfrac{1}{14} \times \dfrac{1}{13} = \dfrac{1}{2730} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ek ek draw ka socha: pehle A (15 mein 1), phir E (14 mein 1), phir I (13 mein 1). Teeno ka zarb wahi jawab deta hai.

blocks.prompt: 17 (b) An urn contains the first 15 English letters (A-O). Sania is to randomly select 3 letters from the urn. She will win the game if the selected letters are the first three vowel letters. Find the probability of Sania winning the game if: (b) The order of the vowel letters does not matter
blocks.explanation:
Ab sirf yeh dekhna hai ke kaunse 3 letters nikle, tarteeb nahi. Is liye outcomes combinations hain: \({}^{15}C_{3}\).
Plan: kul selections ginein, jeetne wala selection \(\{A, E, I\}\) ginein, divide karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: part (a) jaisa, lekin nikalne ki tarteeb ahem nahi.
Humein find karna hai: jeetne ki probability.
Tareeqa: \(P = \frac{\text{winning outcomes}}{\text{all outcomes}}\), jahan outcomes ab selections (groups) hain.

Kul selections
\[{}^{15}C_{3} = \dfrac{15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{2730}{6} = 455\]
Kyun: \({}^{15}P_{3}\) mein har 3-letter group \(3! = 6\) dafa gina gaya tha (har tarteeb alag). Group ek hi dafa ginne ke liye 6 se divide kiya.

Jeetne wale selections
\[\{A, E, I\}: 1\]
Kyun: Pehle teen vowels ka group sirf ek hai. A, E, I kisi bhi tarteeb mein niklein, group wahi hai.

Divide karein
\[P = \dfrac{1}{455}\]
Kyun: 455 barabar imkaan wale selections mein se ek jeetne wala.
Dhyan dein: Part (b) ka imkaan part (a) se zyada hai (\(\frac{1}{455} > \frac{1}{2730}\)), aur yeh mantiqi hai: jab tarteeb ki shart hat jaye to jeetna aasaan ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{3!}{2730} = \dfrac{6}{2730} = \dfrac{1}{455} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Agar tarteeb wale draws hi ginein to A, E, I ki koi bhi 6 tarteebein jeet hain: \(6 \div 2730\), jo wahi \(\frac{1}{455}\) hai.
